{{nihongo|'''Izumianashi Shrine'''|泉穴師神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}{{ill|Izumiōtsu|Q873553|qid=Q873553}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, the {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379}} of {{ill|Izumi Province|ca|Província d'Izumi|ckb|پارێزگای ئیزومی|cs|Provincie Izumi|de|Provinz Izumi|es|Provincia de Izumi|fa|ولایت ایزومی|fr|Province d'Izumi|gl|Provincia de Izumi|hak|Izumi-koet|id|Provinsi Izumi|it|Izumi (provincia)|ja|和泉国|ko|이즈미국|lt|Idzumio žemė|nl|Izumi (provincie)|pt|Província de Izumi|ru|Идзуми (провинция)|simple|Izumi Province|sk|Izumi (provincia)|sr|Провинција Изуми|tr|Izumi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ідзумі|zh|和泉國|zh_min_nan|Izumi-kok|zh_yue|和泉國|qid=Q1047117}}, and its former status in the {{ill|Q712534|lt=former shrine ranking}} was {{ill|Fu-sha|qid=Q134917326}}. "The Forest of Izumianashi Shrine" is selected as one of the {{ill|Ōsaka Midori no Hyakusen|Q11439936|qid=Q11439936}}. {{nihongo|'''Izumianashi Shrine'''|泉穴師神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumi Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
In the {{ill|jinjameisaichou|Q11590704|qid=Q11590704}} compiled in {{ill|1879|Q7783|qid=Q7783}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 12), Tenfukishin and Sakomazuchi-no-Okami are listed as this shrine's deities. However, in the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Jinja Meisaicho}} of {{ill|1894|Q7843|qid=Q7843}} (Meiji 27), the deities are {{ill|Ame-no-oshihomimi|Q462555|qid=Q462555|lt=Ame-no-Oshihomimi-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Takuhadachiji-hime|de|Yorozuhatahime|ja|栲幡千千姫命|ru|Ёродзухататоёакицуси-химэ-но микото|zh|栲幡千千姬命|qid=Q11110848}}, and this shrine follows that interpretation. Izumiotsu City developed a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=textile industry}} in the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} and remains a major textile-producing area today; Takuhatachijihime-no-Mikoto is known as a deity associated with {{ill|Textile|Q28823|qid=Q28823}}.

* Main deities - {{ill|Ame-no-oshihomimi|Q462555|qid=Q462555|lt=Ame-no-Oshihomimi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Takuhadachiji-hime|de|Yorozuhatahime|ja|栲幡千千姫命|ru|Ёродзухататоёакицуси-химэ-но микото|zh|栲幡千千姬命|qid=Q11110848}}

== History ==
According to shrine tradition, this shrine was founded in the first year of {{ill|Hakuhō|Q11580612|qid=Q11580612}} ({{ill|672|Q30601|qid=Q30601}}), though other traditions place its founding in the era of {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803}} or at the time of {{ill|Jimmu's Eastern Expedition|Q11590444|qid=Q11590444}}, so the details are uncertain. According to the Izumi provincial tax register of {{ill|Tenpyō|br|Tenpyō|ca|Era Tenpyō|de|Tempyō|es|Tenpyō|fa|تنپیو|fr|Ère Tenpyō|ia|Tenpyo|id|Tempyō|it|Tenpyō|ja|天平|ko|덴표|no|Tenpyō|pt|Tenpyō|ru|Тэмпё|simple|Tenpyō|sr|Тенпјо|tr|Tenpyō|uk|Темпьо (ненґо)|zh|天平 (日本)|zh_yue|天平 (日本)|qid=Q1199879}} 10 ({{ill|738|Q23585|qid=Q23585}}) in the {{ill|Shōsōin Documents|Q11545362|qid=Q11545362}}, {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|Q349263|qid=Q349263}} granted it 1,300 koku of shrine lands together with {{ill|Ōtori taisha|Q705151|qid=Q705151}}. The {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}} states that in {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=J?gan}} 7 ({{ill|865|Q30350|qid=Q30350}}) it was granted Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade, while the {{ill|Ruijū Kokushi|Q1038639|qid=Q1038639}} states that in J?gan 10 ({{ill|868|Q25061|qid=Q25061}}) it was granted Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade. In the first year of {{ill|Genkō (1331–1334)|Q1194556|qid=Q1194556}} ({{ill|1331|Q6000|qid=Q6000}}), {{ill|Kusunoki Masashige|Q382234|qid=Q382234}} donated a stone lantern to this shrine.

In {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 3 ({{ill|1575|Q6688|qid=Q6688}}), it received a {{ill|shuinjō|Q11093673|qid=Q11093673}} from {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}} confirming its lands. In {{ill|Keichō|ca|Keichō|es|Keichō|fa|کیچو (دوره)|fr|Ère Keichō|id|Keichō|it|Keichō|ja|慶長|ko|게이초|ru|Кэйтё|simple|Keichō|sr|Кеичо|sv|Keichō|th|เคโช|tr|Keichō|uk|Кейтьо|zh|慶長|qid=Q1328185}} 7 ({{ill|1602|Q6727|qid=Q6727}}), {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyori|Q313641|qid=Q313641}} rebuilt the shrine buildings with {{ill|Katagiri Katsumoto|Q1882775|qid=Q1882775}} as magistrate.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6), it was ranked as a {{ill|Q712534|lt=g?sha}}, and in {{ill|1894|Q7843|qid=Q7843}} (Meiji 27) it was promoted to fusha. In {{ill|1946|Q18610|qid=Q18610}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|ar|فترة شووا|br|Oadvezh Shōwa|ca|Període Shōwa|cs|Období Šówa|de|Shōwa-Zeit|eo|Ŝova-epoko|es|Era Shōwa|eu|Shōwa aroa|fa|دوره شووا|fi|Shōwa-kausi|fr|Ère Shōwa (1926-1989)|he|תקופת שווה|hi|शोवा युग|hu|Sóva-kor|id|Zaman Shōwa|it|Periodo Shōwa|ja|昭和|ka|შოვას პერიოდი|ko|쇼와 시대|lt|Šiova laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Shōwa|nl|Showaperiode|no|Shōwa-perioden|pl|Shōwa|pt|Período Shōwa|ru|Сёва|simple|Shōwa era|sr|Шова период|sv|Shōwa|th|ยุคโชวะ|tl|Panahong Shōwa|tr|Şova Dönemi|uk|Період Сьова|vi|Thời kỳ Chiêu Hòa|zh|昭和|zh_classical|昭和|zh_min_nan|Chiau-hô|zh_yue|昭和|qid=Q327567}} 21), the spring grand festival, previously held annually on February 4, was moved to April 5, and that schedule continues today.

== Precinct ==
* Honden ({{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Q1188622|qid=Q1188622}}) - Rebuilt in {{ill|Keichō|ca|Keichō|es|Keichō|fa|کیچو (دوره)|fr|Ère Keichō|id|Keichō|it|Keichō|ja|慶長|ko|게이초|ru|Кэйтё|simple|Keichō|sr|Кеичо|sv|Keichō|th|เคโช|tr|Keichō|uk|Кейтьо|zh|慶長|qid=Q1328185}} 7 ({{ill|1602|Q6727|qid=Q6727}}) by {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyori|Q313641|qid=Q313641}} with {{ill|Katagiri Katsumoto|Q1882775|qid=Q1882775}} as magistrate.
* Lantern - Donated by {{ill|Kusunoki Masashige|Q382234|qid=Q382234}} in the first year of {{ill|Genkō (1331–1334)|Q1194556|qid=Q1194556}} ({{ill|1331|Q6000|qid=Q6000}}).
* Haiden (Izumiotsu City designated tangible cultural property) - Rebuilt in the Keich? era ({{ill|1596|Q6785|qid=Q6785}} - {{ill|1615|Q6784|qid=Q6784}}) by Toyotomi Hideyori with Katagiri Katsumoto as magistrate. Two torii (Izumiotsu City designated tangible cultural properties) stand in front of the haiden; one was prepared for each of the two married deities enshrined in the honden.
* Shrine office
* Distant worship site
* Sacred {{ill|Camphora officinarum|ab|Акамфараҵла|af|Kanferboom|an|Cinnamomum camphora|ar|كافور (نبات)|arz|كافور (نبات)|ast|Cinnamomum camphora|az|Camphora officinarum|be|Камфоравае дрэва|bg|Камфорово дърво|bn|কর্পূর গাছ|ca|Camforer|ceb|Dalapot|cs|Kafrovník lékařský|da|Kamfertræ|de|Kampferbaum|dv|ކާފޫރު ގަސް|eo|Kamforarbo|es|Cinnamomum camphora|eu|Kanforrondo|fa|درخت کافور|fi|Kamferipuu|fr|Camphrier|frr|Kamferbuum|gl|Alcanforeiro|hi|कपूर|hr|Kamforovo drvo|hsb|Kamferowy štom|hu|Kámforfa|hy|Կամֆորայի ծառ|id|Camphora officinarum|it|Cinnamomum camphora|ja|クスノキ|ka|ქაფურის ხე|kk|Камфора ағашы|kn|ಕರ್ಪೂರ ಮರ|ko|녹나무|ku|Dara kamfûrê|la|Cinnamomum camphora|mg|Camphora officinarum|ml|കർപ്പൂരം|ms|Kapur tohori|my|ပရုတ်ပင်|ne|कपुरको रूख|nl|Kamferboom|nn|Kamfertre|no|Kamfertre|oc|Camfrièr|or|କର୍ପୁର|pa|ਕਪੂਰ (ਦਰੱਖ਼ਤ)|pl|Cynamonowiec kamforowy|pt|Cinnamomum camphora|pwn|drakes|qu|Alkachu|ru|Коричник камфорный|sl|Kafrovec|sv|Kamferträd|ta|கற்பூர மரம்|te|సిన్నామోనం కాంఫొర|th|การบูร (พรรณไม้)|tr|Kâfur ağacı|uk|Камфорне дерево|vi|Long não (cây)|war|Cinnamomum camphora|za|Gaucah|zh|樟树|zh_min_nan|Chiuⁿ-á|zh_yue|樟|qid=Q158722}} - Protected tree of Izumiotsu City.

== Auxiliary shrines ==
* Sumiyoshi-sha (Important Cultural Property) - Built in {{ill|Bun'ei|Q1010103|qid=Q1010103}} 10 ({{ill|1273|Q5526|qid=Q5526}}). It is the oldest honden architecture in Osaka Prefecture.
* Anashi Tenmang? (g?shi-den; Izumiotsu Furusato Cultural Heritage) - Relocated in {{ill|1908|Q2056|qid=Q2056}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 41) from the honden of Sugawara Shrine in Itahara Village.
* Kasuga-sha (Important Cultural Property) - Rebuilt in Keich? 7 (1602) by Toyotomi Hideyori with Katagiri Katsumoto as magistrate.
* ?kuninushi-sha - Enshrined deities: {{ill|Ōkuninushi|abstract|Q276944|ca|Ōkuninushi|es|Ōkuninushi|fa|اوکونینوشی|fr|Ōkuninushi|hu|Ókuninusi|id|Ookuninushi|it|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主|ko|오오쿠니누시|mni|ꯑꯣꯀꯨꯅꯤꯅꯨꯁꯤ|pl|Ōkuninushi|pt|Ookuninushi|ru|Окунинуси|simple|Ōkuninushi|sr|Okuninuši|sv|Ōkuninushi|tr|Ōkuninushi|uk|Окунінуші|vi|Ōkuninushi|zh|大國主|qid=Q276944}}-no-Mikoto, {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611}}-no-Mikoto, {{ill|Ichikishima-hime|Q11059454|qid=Q11059454|qid=Q11059454|lt=Ichikishimahime-no-Mikoto}}
* Kusunoki-sha - Enshrined deity: {{ill|Kusunoki Masashige|Q382234|qid=Q382234}}
* Hy?zu-sha - Enshrined deity: Yachihoko-no-Kami

== Festivals ==
* New Year's Day Festival (January 1)
* Ebisu Festival (January 10)
* Yakuyoke Prayer Festival (February 3)
* Spring Grand Festival (April 5)
* Nagoshi no ?harae (June 30)
* Summer Shrine Festival (July 15)
* Autumn Grand Festival (day before {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Health and Sports Day}})
* Takuhata Festival (November 1)
* Winter Shrine Festival (December 15)
